# Ammo Bugs

Source: [wiki article 2160](../archive/2160.md); edited 2024-06-04.

<a id="wiki-2160-n1"></a>

- Article reports Get/Set Ammo and Get/Set Max Ammo returning zero for all clips on Mauga, Venture, Kiriko and Lifeweaver, without a known workaround.

<a id="wiki-2160-n2"></a>

- Bastion Assault clip 1 is documented as 300 ammo that does not deplete, usable to trigger reload animation through Workshop.
